buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Service & Support The Service Provider must own 30% of the bid quantity of vehicles in Service Provider’s name or in the name of the proprietor / partner of the Service Provider. Necessary documents relating to proof of ownership will be uploaded by the bidder for verification of the buyer. Such Service Provider owned vehicles will be part of the fleet to be deployed by the Service Provider in case he gets the contract against this bid.

2. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 3. Past Project Experience Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc.Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc. 4. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses EXTENSION OF CONTRACT: IIFT will have the right to extend this contract on the same rates, terms & cond itions at one time or in spells of a lesser time period up to a cumulative maximum period of one year or till an alternative arrangement is made whichever is earlier. No increase in the rates shall be entertained at any stage/extension. Termination Clauses: contract may be terminated by the Institute by one month's notice and three months by the service provider. Notwithstanding that the contractor neglects or fails to carry out the contracted w ork due to negligence in the performance of the contract, the Institute shall have the right to terminate the contract forthwith an d forfeit the entire security amount as well as engage another supplier / service prov ider to carry out the work / service at the cost and risk of agency. Availability of Office: The bidder shall have an office located in the local area i.e., in Kakinada. As proof of the local office address, the bidder shall submit certificate under GST Registrati on Certificate/MSME Registration Certificate showing the local office address. Age Criteria: All contractual employees provided by the Vendor shall be not less than 20 ye ars of age. The Tenderer/Bidder shall have at least 5 years’ experience in the relevant field (i.e. Hiring of Vehicle services only) in any educational institution, Government office/PSUs. The Bidder should furnish a latest Banks Solvency Certificate from a Scheduled Bank for an amount equal to 40% of the estimated cost i.e. Rs. 12.00 lakhs. As per Annexure XIII. ATC document The PDF file uploaded should be readable and shall not be password protected. Buyer reserves all the rights to cancel the bid at any time without specifying the reasons. Firms not replying to queries based on technical bids within the specified time will be reject ed. In the matter of any dispute the decision of the buyer of the organization will be final.
